description: This file contains functions for handling protobuf field masks, including parsing JSON request bodies to generate field mask paths, and utility functions for protobuf message reflection.

methods.name: getFieldByName
methods.description: Retrieves a protobuf field descriptor by name or JSON name from a set of field descriptors.

methods.name: FieldMaskFromRequestBody
methods.description: Creates a protobuf FieldMask from a JSON request body, extracting all complete paths.

methods.name: isProtobufAnyMessage
methods.description: Checks if a message descriptor corresponds to the protobuf 'Any' type.

methods.name: isDynamicProtoMessage
methods.description: Checks if a message descriptor corresponds to dynamic protobuf message types like Struct or Value.

methods.name: buildPathsBlindly
methods.description: Generates all subpaths from a JSON object without matching to proto field names, relying solely on JSON structure.
